content: Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00337 An RTE_E_DET_ILLEGAL_INVOCATION (0x03) shall be reported by the RTE when it determines that an RTE API is called by a Runnable which should not call that RTE API. The RTE can identify the active Runnable when it dispatches the RTE Event and if it subsequently receives a call from that Runnable to an API that is not part of its contract then this particular error ID must me logged.
